description: This photograph depicts a dense urban residential area, likely in Tallinn, Estonia, featuring multiple multi-story buildings. Many buildings have distinct dark grey sloped roofs with numerous dormer windows. The building facades are painted in a variety of pastel colours, including pink, light blue, and light grey. In the foreground, lower buildings with different architectural styles, some with tiled roofs, are visible, interspersed with green trees. The sky is overcast. The partial caption beneath the image reads: "Urban f[abric] of class 1.1.1 (Tallinn, [unreadable])", indicating it serves as an example for the Copernicus Land Monitoring Service (CLMS) Land Use / Land Cover (LULC) class 1.1.1, defined as "Urban fabric (predominantly public and private units)".
